rv.q: Abbensetts was the first black British playwright to write a TV drama series (the BBC’s 1978 show Empire Road), and had other distinctive credits. But since Little Napoleons (1994), the C4 mini-series about warring solicitors, his pioneering efforts have been overlooked.
